title: Feelings
description: Say how you feel and respond when someone else does.

questions.sentence: tu khush aahes ka?

nahi, mi gharat aahe.
ho, mala cutting chai pahije.
questions.correctAnswer: ho, mi khup khush aahe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy.

questions.sentence: mi aaj khup khush aahe.
options: I am very happy today.
I am very tired today.
I am at home today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: tu dukhi aahes ka?
options: ho, mala thoda vait vatate.
ho, mala vada pav avadto.
nahi, mi aata kam karto.

questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I feel a little sad.

questions.sentence: mala aaj vait vatate.
options: I feel sad today.
I feel fine today.
I am busy today.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel sad today.

questions.sentence: aaj mazha vadhdivas aahe.

mala te mahit nahi hote.
mi udya gharich aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: arre vaa, khup khup abhinandan!
questions.translatedSentence: Oh wonderful, many congratulations!

questions.sentence: tu aaj khup khush distos.
options: You look very happy today.
You look very tired today.
You are very busy today.

mi gharat ekta aahe.

We are all tired.
questions.correctAnswer: We are all happy.

questions.sentence: mi aaj khup dukhi aahe.
options: ka? kay zala?
chaan, mala aavadle.
ho, mi pan khush aahe.
questions.correctAnswer: ka? kay zala?

options: mag thoda aram kar.
mag apan baher jau ya.
ho, mala pan rag ala aahe.

mi udya Punyala jato aahe.

questions.sentence: mala andharachi bhiti vatate.
options: I am scared of the dark.
I am scared of dogs.
I do not go out at night.
questions.correctAnswer: I am scared of the dark.

questions.sentence: mala ratri ekta gharat bhiti vatate.
options: ghabru nakos, mi aahe na.
chaan, mala pan te avadte.
ho, tu khup khush aahes.

options: I am bored of this work.

options: mhanun tu itka thaklela distos.

mala pan andharachi bhiti vatate.

questions.sentence: tu ithe ekta ka basla aahes?

mala vada pav khup avadto.

ho, mala te khup avadte.

What are you doing today?

What happened? Why are you so angry?

options: kahi nahi, mala aaichi athavan yete.
kahi nahi, mala aata jhop yete.
ho, mi aaj khup khush zalo.

questions.sentence: mala sang, tula nakki kay zale aahe?
options: Tell me, what has really happened to you?
Tell me, what do you really want?
Tell me, where do you really want to go?
questions.correctAnswer: Tell me, what has really happened to you?

questions.sentence: tumhi kashachi tari kalaji karat aahat ka?
options: ho, mulacha ajun phone ala nahi.
ho, mala aaj cutting chai pyaychi aahe.

questions.sentence: tumhala aata kase vatate aahe?
options: How are you feeling now?
What do you want now?
How did you feel earlier?

options: chal, apan cutting chai piu ani bolu ya.

ho, mala vada pav khup avadto.

You are not wrong, we all think the same thing.

mala pan he kam mahit nahi.

Get up, take your bag and come with me.

mag apan aaj officela jau ya.
